I like to upvoat and out of possibly poor habits I hit the back arrow to return to the subverse or page (because submissions and comments don't open in a new tab/window). It looks like all the happy upvoats I've given to you all disappear.
Does hitting the 'back' arrow undo my voats?
Refresh and the votes will still be there.
So if I upvoat again after back arrowing will that negate the previous upvoat?

Disclaimer: I haven't actually viewed Voat's source code, but I feel these are fairly safe assumptions. Sorry I'm not the best at explaining, but I figure I'll at least try to help explain what's going on the best I can. I'm sure someone better at web design than me will come along and explain better than me soon.
/Disclaimer

~~

Basically what you're seeing is the javascript/css values(Local code in your browser) of your voats become out of synch with what is on the server (The status of your voats are likely stored on the servers in a MySQL database via C#).

When you press the Forward Arrow the information from the database is not requested from the server, so your browser does not update the CSS(visual appearance) for the upvoat/downvoat arrows. So the arrows appear inside your browser as their default values. Though the information IS requested by your browser from the server when you refresh or navigate through a link, and you can get an accurate status on what your voats look like this way.
